title: (C#) SceneTree interaction has heavy performance penalty (regression since 4.6+)
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.7.1.stable.mono.official [a13da4feb], 4.6.3-stable (official)

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6950 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21043.5001) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I developed an C# addon for Godot 4.5. On that version everything works flawless. I decided to upgrade to the newest engine version and noticed that something is off. The performance was poor out of nowhere. After some testing i isolated the issue and prepared an MRP project example that shows the issue in detail.

For C# [Tool] scripts specifically, the time to remove a node increased, jumping from negligible overhead in 4.5.1 (compared to an node without an script attached) to an +700% performance penalty regression in 4.7.1.

It seems also that the more complex the attached script to the node is, the more the performance penalty will be. (In my addon at least is way heavier, while still having only like 500 nodes in the scene the lag is way more severe freezing the editor for multiple seconds)
In this MRP only an minimal dummy C# script is attached so its the best case. 

Also: this issue doesnt appear, if we skip node.owner assignment (so that it is not visible in scenetree).

#### Godot 4.5 Benchmark
```
=======================================================
=== FINAL AVERAGED RESULTS (5000 Nodes, 3 Runs) ===
Godot Engine Version: 4.5.1-stable (official)
Show in Scene Tree:   true
-------------------------------------------------------
1. AVG SPAWN PERFORMANCE (Adding 5000 nodes)
None Spawn Time:       0.306 seconds
GDScript Spawn Time:   0.343 seconds
C# Spawn Time:         0.571 seconds

Overhead compared to None (Scriptless Baseline):
  GDScript Overhead:   +12.2%
  C# Overhead:         +86.5%
-------------------------------------------------------
2. AVG REMOVAL PERFORMANCE (Removing 1 node from 5000)
None Removal Time:     0.451 seconds
GDScript Removal Time: 0.456 seconds
C# Removal Time:       0.448 seconds

Overhead compared to None (Scriptless Baseline):
  GDScript Overhead:   +1.2%
  C# Overhead:         +-0.7%
=======================================================
```
#### Godot 4.7 Benchmark
```
=======================================================
=== FINAL AVERAGED RESULTS (5000 Nodes, 3 Runs) ===
Godot Engine Version: 4.7.1-stable (official)
Show in Scene Tree:   true
-------------------------------------------------------
1. AVG SPAWN PERFORMANCE (Adding 5000 nodes)
None Spawn Time:       0.288 seconds
GDScript Spawn Time:   0.697 seconds
C# Spawn Time:         1.729 seconds

Overhead compared to None (Scriptless Baseline):
  GDScript Overhead:   +142.3%
  C# Overhead:         +501.2%
-------------------------------------------------------
2. AVG REMOVAL PERFORMANCE (Removing 1 node from 5000)
None Removal Time:     0.165 seconds
GDScript Removal Time: 0.544 seconds
C# Removal Time:       1.329 seconds

Overhead compared to None (Scriptless Baseline):
  GDScript Overhead:   +229.5%
  C# Overhead:         +705.5%
=======================================================
```

### Steps to reproduce

I prepared an benchamrk MRP project. (see at bottom of page). I measured 4.5, 4.6 and 4.7 engine versions.
To start it open the project, compile the C# DLL assembly, open Sandbox.tscn, select the root node and in inspector press the "Full benchmark" button to start the benchmark with default settings.




### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[dotnet_scenetree_perf_regression.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31033903/dotnet_scenetree_perf_regression.zip)
